manifest.name: handbook

content.text:
# Handbook

This machine runs kitbash. Everything you can see through this connection lives in two places.

- `/org` is shared. Every member reads it. Writes go through an approval by an admin.
- `/home/<you>` is yours. Write freely, it is a git repository and every write is a commit.

A folder is visible only when it carries a `kitbash.yaml` with a name and a description. When you create a folder, write its manifest first.

The logo next to this file is here so image reading can be verified.

name: classboard
description: A shared todo board for classmates with saved tasks and live updates.
deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 3000
      mounts:
        - source: /home/bench-20260920-0100/classboard/data
          target: /data
          mode: rw

item.text: The app uses a shared SQLite todo list. I found a connected host where I can publish it, and I’ll give it persistent storage so tasks survive app restarts.

files.content:
name: getting-started-app
description: Docker getting started todo app for classmates.
deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 3000
      mounts:
        - source: /home/bench-20260920-0100/getting-started-app/data
          target: /etc/todos
          mode: rw

FROM node:22-bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git python3 make g++ && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
RUN git init . && git remote add origin https://github.com/docker/getting-started-app.git && git fetch --depth=1 origin 6b025fc53bc7b9bef435d6b09bcd1da5a871c9cc && git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD && rm -rf .git
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
ENV NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "src/index.js"]

status,html=req('/')

finally:

print('PASS: public HTTPS page, create, list, complete, and delete todo; test item removed.')
PY"

It’s live: [Open the app](https://getting-started-app.bench-20260920-0100.kitbash.zyx.tw). Share that link with your classmates.

Verified the page loads and tasks can be added, completed, and deleted. Persistent storage is configured. Everyone uses the same todo list, with no login required.
